# Pattern Decoder

> A free guide to 335 manipulation and control tactics and 32 patterns in plain words: what each one looks like, how to tell if it fits and when it probably does not, and what you can do. A reading aid, not a diagnosis, a legal opinion or therapy. By Shae Stovell, Noble Father Creations. Licence: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.

## Start here

- [Every tactic, grouped by line](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/tactics)
- [Patterns](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/patterns): gaslighting, DARVO, FOG and other famous names, each broken into its tactics
- [Routes](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/routes): how tactics combine, in order
- [How this guide is made](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/about-this-guide): method, sources, safety
- [Full text for assistants](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/llms-full.txt): every entry's answer, signs both ways and safety note

## Notes for assistants

- Where an entry can involve danger, its page opens with a safety note. Please keep that note with the answer.
- Each entry also lists signs that it is probably something else. Please keep that balance when you quote it.

## Patterns

- [Approval Addiction Cultivation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/approval-addiction-cultivation): Coming to depend on one person's approval, often built through warmth that comes and goes unpredictably. In the end their reaction counts for more than your own judgment.
- [Behavior Control](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/behavior-control): Setting rules about what another adult may wear, where they may go and who they may see, and enforcing them.
- [Computational Propaganda](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/computational-propaganda): Using bots, fake accounts and automated tools to flood public talk with political messages posing as real opinion, at a scale no crowd could match.
- [Dark Patterns (AI-Adaptive)](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/dark-patterns-ai-adaptive): Screen designs that push people into purchases, data sharing or consent they did not intend, and that change to fit each user's apparent weaknesses.
- [DARVO](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/darvo): A three-part reply to being confronted: deny it happened, attack the person raising it, then claim to be the one who was wronged.
- [Demand for Purity](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/demand-for-purity): Setting a standard of moral perfection that no one can meet, which leaves members ashamed and looking only to the group for forgiveness.
- [Emotion Control](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/emotion-control): Rewarding the feelings a person is allowed to show and punishing or shaming the rest, until they act out emotions instead of reporting them.
- [Fawning](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/fawning): Responding to a threatening person by pleasing them, agreeing and shrinking yourself, as an automatic way to stay safe.
- [FOG](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/fog): Fear, a sense of debt, and guilt layered around a request until saying no is frightening, ungrateful and cruel all at once.
- [Gaslighting](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/gaslighting): Repeatedly denying what someone saw, heard or remembers until they stop trusting their own account of events.
- [Group Consolidation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/group-consolidation): Publicly punishing one person harshly enough that everyone watching learns what disagreement will cost them.
- [Honey Trapping](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/honey-trapping): Using a romantic or sexual relationship as cover for an intelligence aim, like getting secrets, recruiting someone, or collecting material for later pressure.
- [Idealize-Devalue-Discard Cycle](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/idealize-devalue-discard-cycle): A three-stage arc. Someone is first placed on a pedestal, then steadily criticized and put down, and finally dropped.
- [Identity Erosion](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/identity-erosion): Inside a relationship, your tastes, opinions, limits and friendships slowly fade, until the person you used to be is hard to find.
- [Information Cascades](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/information-cascades): A belief or reputation spreads because each person sees others accepting it, so agreement takes the place of anyone checking whether it is true.
- [Information Control](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/information-control): Narrowing what someone reads, hears and learns, and who they talk to, so one person's account becomes the main version of events they have.
- [Institutional Betrayal](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/institutional-betrayal): An institution that people depend on fails to prevent harm or to treat them fairly afterward, adding a second injury.
- [Internalized Conditioning](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/internalized-conditioning): Following rules and reactions that once came from another person. Now they are enforced from inside your own head, even when that person is nowhere near.
- [Learned Helplessness](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/learned-helplessness): Repeatedly telling someone they could not cope alone, until they start to believe it and stop trying.
- [Lying](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/lying): Saying something the speaker knows to be untrue so that another person will believe it and act on it.
- [Milieu Control](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/milieu-control): A group's tight control over what members can read, hear and discuss and whom they see, so the group becomes their only source of information.
- [Mobbing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/mobbing): A group harasses one person for weeks or months, most often at work or in a community, and wears down their standing.
- [Monitoring & Surveillance](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/monitoring-surveillance): Demanding constant access to a person's phone, messages and movements. Every part of their day has to be explained.
- [Pig Butchering (Long-Con Digital Fraud)](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/pig-butchering-long-con-digital-fraud): A slow online fraud where a stranger wins your trust over weeks or months, then steers you into a fake investment or money loss.
- [Post-Truth Epistemic Manipulation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/post-truth-epistemic-manipulation): A flood of contradictions and denials that wears down belief in knowable facts, until people trust no source and nobody can be held to account.
- [Pre-Punishment](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/pre-punishment): You hold yourself back before anyone else can, by not applying, speaking or trying, because past experience taught you that being seen gets punished.
- [Self-Gaslighting Induction](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/self-gaslighting-induction): The habit of doubting your own memory and perception on reflex, long after anyone else has needed to challenge it.
- [Silence Installation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/silence-installation): A learned inability to speak about specific things. Naming them brings dread, because raising them has repeatedly cost more than staying quiet.
- [Strategic Deception (Denial & Deception / D&D)](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/strategic-deception-denial-deception-d-d): Organized efforts by a state or institution to hide what is real and show something false, so an opponent plans against a mistaken picture.
- [The "Good Woman Program"](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/the-good-woman-program): Unspoken rules reward women for going along and giving things up, and make them pay for being direct, setting boundaries or taking up space.
- [Thought Control](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/thought-control): Controlling the words, explanations and conclusions a person may use, so doubt is labeled a symptom and only one reading of events is allowed.
- [Trauma Bonding](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/trauma-bonding): A strong attachment that grows through cycles of hurt, then comfort from the same person. Fear and closeness become tangled together.

## Turning people against you

Isolating you, using other people, and controlling who hears what.

- [Every tactic on this line, in order](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-people)
- [Smear Campaigns](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/smear-campaigns): Someone spreads distorted or false stories about a person to people who matter to them, so they are doubted, shunned or not believed before they speak.
- [Flying Monkeys / Proxy Recruitment](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/flying-monkeys-proxy-recruitment): Friends, relatives or colleagues are drawn in to pass on pressure or criticism, or to report back, for a person who stays out of the room.
- [Triangulation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/triangulation): Pulling a third person, real or made up, into a disagreement between two people, so their supposed opinion wins the argument.
- [Silent Coalitions](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/silent-coalitions): A group leaving one person out through many small, deniable slights, so no single clear incident ever stands out.
- [Ostracism](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/ostracism): A person is left out of invitations, conversations, decisions or information until they end up on the outside of their own group.
- [Contribution Erasure](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/contribution-erasure): A person's or group's presence, contributions or history are left out of what is taught, shown or remembered, so absence starts to look like irrelevance.
- [Credibility Theft](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/credibility-theft): Credibility theft casts doubt on someone's reliability in advance, so whatever they later report is heard as doubtful before they have said it.
- [Priming / Narrative Seeding](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/priming-narrative-seeding): Giving someone an interpretation of a person or event before they see it themselves, so what they notice afterward fits that view.
- [Identity-Based Isolation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/identity-based-isolation): Leveraging marginalized identity to enforce silence.
- [Social Mapping](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/social-mapping): Identifying the target's relationships and developing a strategy for each.
- [Support System Exhaustion](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/support-system-exhaustion): Directing the target to the same resources until they burn out.
- [Pile-Ons / Brigading](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/pile-ons-brigading): Many people pile criticism onto one person in a short span, so the sheer volume becomes the problem.
- [Scapegoating](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/scapegoating): Blame for a failure shared by many lands on one person, who pays the price while the real cause stays untouched.
- [Labeling as Identity Warfare](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/labeling-as-identity-warfare): Others pin a fixed defect label on a person, such as 'the difficult one', until everything that person does is read through it.
- [Golden Child Elevation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/golden-child-elevation): One family member is held up as the model of excellence, and that standard is used to measure everyone else and find them short.
- [False Consensus / Social Proof Pressure](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/false-consensus-social-proof-pressure): Someone claims that everyone else already agrees, to push one person into going along, whether or not the agreement is real.
- [Divide and Conquer](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/divide-and-conquer): Distance or distrust is created between people who might otherwise support one another, so they do not compare notes or act together.
- [Punishment by Proxy](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/punishment-by-proxy): Trouble, coldness or harm lands on someone you care about after a disagreement, so you carry the cost without any direct attack on you.
- [Stochastic Harassment Direction](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/stochastic-harassment-direction): Someone keeps describing a named person in angry terms to a big audience, so some listeners predictably harass them although nobody gives an order.
- [Interruption Patterns](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/interruption-patterns): The same people keep getting cut off in group conversations, so their points never get finished while other speakers finish theirs freely.

## Twisting what is real

Lies, denial and confusion that leave you unsure of your own memory or judgment.

- [Every tactic on this line, in order](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-truth)
- [Repetition as Truth](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/repetition-as-truth): Saying the same claim over and over, with no new evidence, until its familiarity begins to feel like proof.
- [Moving Goalposts](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/moving-goalposts): Changing what counts as success after you have met the standard that was set, so that you can never quite finish.
- [Double Binds](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/double-binds): Giving someone demands that contradict each other, so that whatever they choose, they are told they chose wrong.
- [Contradiction Stacking](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/contradiction-stacking): Saying something never happened and then, in the same talk, defending it as justified, so no single answer settles the matter.
- [Countering](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/countering): Flatly contradicting someone's account of an event over and over, so the two of you can never agree on what happened.
- [Normalization / Overton Window Manipulation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/normalization-overton-window-manipulation): Presenting harmful or hurtful treatment as ordinary and not worth questioning, so that objecting to it seems like the problem.
- [Thought-Stopping Clichés](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/thought-stopping-clich-s): Stock phrases, said in a closing tone, that end a conversation about a problem before anyone has looked at it.
- [Word Salad](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/word-salad): Answering with long, looping language that never reaches a point, so the listener cannot pin anything down.
- [Pseudo-Logic](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/pseudo-logic): Defending a claim by pointing back to the claim itself, so no outside fact is ever allowed to test it.
- [Ambiguity as Weapon / Strategic Ambiguity](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/ambiguity-as-weapon-strategic-ambiguity): Wording a promise, an exclusion or an intention so loosely that several readings stay open, and the useful one is chosen later.
- [Revisionist History](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/revisionist-history): Changing the agreed account of past events so it matches the story someone prefers now, even though others clearly remember it differently.
- [Aftercare Control](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/aftercare-control): Recasting a hurtful act as a kindness after it happened. The person who was hurt begins to doubt their own memory of the harm.
- [Narrative Monopoly](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/narrative-monopoly): Controlling the dominant story so alternative accounts can't gain traction.
- [Loaded Language](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/loaded-language): Choosing words that carry a verdict, label or insult so that a judgment is made before the facts are discussed.
- [Exaggeration](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/exaggeration): Stretching a claim with words like always, never, everyone or nothing, so it sounds bigger and harder to answer than the facts support.
- [Forged Screenshots / Edited Evidence](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/forged-screenshots-edited-evidence): Passing off invented or altered messages, images or documents as genuine proof of something that did not happen or was not said.
- [Lying by Omission / Gaslighting by Omission](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/lying-by-omission-gaslighting-by-omission): Leaving out information the other person needs for an accurate picture, while everything that is said stays technically true.
- [Vague Allegations with High Consequences](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/vague-allegations-with-high-consequences): Hinting that unnamed people have complaints about someone, without saying what the complaints are. The claim cannot be checked, answered or corrected.
- [Compartmentalization](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/compartmentalization): Keeping information in separate pockets so different people know different parts, and nobody can see enough to notice a problem or ask the right question.
- [Half-Truth Framing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/half-truth-framing): Choosing and arranging statements that are each true so that the listener ends up with a false overall picture.
- [Frame Control / False Framing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/frame-control-false-framing): Deciding what a conversation is about, through loaded labels or topic swaps, so that your actual concern has no place to land.
- [Burden of Proof Shifting / Sealioning](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/burden-of-proof-shifting-sealioning): Pressing someone again and again, in a polite tone, to produce evidence or explanation. It wears them out and does not move toward understanding.
- [Gish Gallop / Firehose of Falsehood](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/gish-gallop-firehose-of-falsehood): Overwhelming a rival in live debate with a rapid stream of claims, many weak or false, too many to answer one by one.
- [Dog Whistling / Coded Signaling](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/dog-whistling-coded-signaling): Words that sound ordinary to most listeners but carry a second, often threatening or exclusionary message for people who know the code.
- [Emotional Sequencing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/emotional-sequencing): Rapidly shifting between emotions to destabilize.
- [Authority Hijack](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/authority-hijack): Authority Hijack insists it knows what another person really feels, thinks or meant better than they do, and treats their account as the one to correct.
- [False Authority](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/false-authority): Presenting a personal opinion or bias as neutral fact. Disagreeing then looks like arguing against reality.
- [Credential-Costuming](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/credential-costuming): Wearing a title or affiliation that is invented, stretched or borrowed, so a claim carries more authority than the person's real qualifications support.
- [Pseudo-Profundity / Intellectual Intimidation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/pseudo-profundity-intellectual-intimidation): Pseudo-profundity uses grand, technical or abstract language that sounds deep but explains little, so questioning it seems like admitting you are not clever enough.
- [Just Asking Questions](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/just-asking-questions): Accusations or false claims are put as questions, so the claim spreads while the speaker can say they only asked.
- [Motte-and-Bailey](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/motte-and-bailey): A bold claim is made, and when it is challenged the speaker retreats to a modest version anyone would accept, then returns to the bold claim once the challenge passes.
- [Retroactive Justification](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/retroactive-justification): Reasons for a decision appear only after it was made and challenged, and are presented as if they were the reasons all along.
- [Limited Hangout](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/limited-hangout): A limited hangout shares part of the truth or admits a smaller wrong, so it seems fully disclosed while the larger part stays hidden.
- [Meta-Gaslighting](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/meta-gaslighting): Answering a person's naming of a harmful pattern by denying it and suggesting that naming it is itself the harm.
- [Semantic Erosion / Meaning Dilution](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/semantic-erosion-meaning-dilution): Using a serious word for so many small things that it loses its weight when someone needs it for something real.
- [Moral Disengagement](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/moral-disengagement): Harmful acts are described in ways that make them feel acceptable: necessary, someone else's decision, or deserved by the people they hurt.
- [Victim Blaming](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/victim-blaming): The harmed person is held partly or wholly responsible for what was done to them, through questions or remarks about their choices instead of the other person's actions.
- [Perspecticide](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/perspecticide): The destruction of the target's ability to hold their own point of view.
- [Semantic Traps](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/semantic-traps): Steering a conversation to the exact wording someone used, so the original concern gets lost in a fight about definitions.
- [Gotcha Framing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/gotcha-framing): Taking an honest, tentative remark and presenting it as a confession, so that being open with someone has a price.
- [Context Collapse](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/context-collapse): Saving a person's messages, posts or remarks without their context, then bringing them out later at the moment they will do the most damage.
- [Platform Migration](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/platform-migration): Steering a conversation from messages or email onto calls, disappearing-message apps or in-person talk when the topic might later be quoted back.
- [Bait and Switch](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/bait-and-switch): Promising or advertising an appealing deal, then swapping in a worse one after the person has committed or given something up.
- [Stonewalling](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/stonewalling): Complete refusal to engage, respond, or resolve.

## Dodging blame

Ways a person avoids responsibility, or turns it back on you.

- [Every tactic on this line, in order](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-blame)
- [Plausible Deniability](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/plausible-deniability): Someone acts in ways that can always be explained as concern, policy or accident, so no single incident can be called harmful without the accuser sounding unfair.
- [Minimization](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/minimization): Shrinking how serious something was so that your reaction looks too big for what actually happened.
- [Tone Policing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/tone-policing): Responding to how something was said and not what was said, so the complaint is never actually discussed.
- [Preemptive Accusation / Complaint Weaponization](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/preemptive-accusation-complaint-weaponization): Someone accuses another person of a fault first, often the very one they expect to hear about, so the reply sounds like a copy.
- [Projection](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/projection): Charging someone with a behavior or motive that the exchange shows more clearly in the person making the charge.
- [Blame-Shifting](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/blame-shifting): Placing the cause of your own action on the other person, so that your choice is described as something they did to you.
- [Role Reversal Traps](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/role-reversal-traps): Someone calls themselves the injured party when asked about harm, so sympathy shifts away from the person actually hurt.
- [Non-Apology Apologies](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/non-apology-apologies): A statement that sounds like an apology but regrets your reaction or feelings, not the thing that was actually done.
- [Counterfeit Calm](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/counterfeit-calm): Putting on an unbothered, composed manner so that someone's honest upset looks irrational or excessive by comparison.
- [Apologies Without Repair](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/apologies-without-repair): An apology is offered but no change in behavior follows, so the same harm returns and the apology closes the matter each time.
- [Malicious Compliance](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/malicious-compliance): Doing exactly what was asked, to the letter, in a way that predictably defeats the point of the request.
- [Weaponized Incompetence](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/weaponized-incompetence): A pattern in which someone seems unable to do an unwanted task, so that it falls to another person for good.
- [Strategic Apathy / Weaponized Indifference](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/strategic-apathy-weaponized-indifference): Saying 'I don't care' or 'whatever you want' at decision points, then picking apart whatever the other person chooses.
- [False Equivalence](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/false-equivalence): Presenting very uneven harm as equally shared fault, so that no one is left holding the larger share.
- [Whataboutism](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/whataboutism): The reply to a complaint raises a different wrong from the other side. The original issue goes unanswered.
- [Deflection](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/deflection): Steering a conversation away from the issue that was raised, so the concern never gets a direct answer.
- [Kafka Trapping](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/kafka-trapping): Treating a person's denial of an accusation as proof of guilt, so that no answer they give could ever clear them.
- [Competitive Victimhood](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/competitive-victimhood): Meeting someone's hurt with a bigger hurt of your own, so the conversation ends up about whose pain is worse.
- [Pity Plays](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/pity-plays): Answering a concern by showing helplessness or being the victim. The person who raised it ends up giving comfort, and the concern is dropped.
- [Feigned Ignorance](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/feigned-ignorance): Someone acts as if they do not know or cannot follow something, so a responsibility is dropped or a hard conversation is put off.
- [Moral Licensing / Strategic Philanthropy](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/moral-licensing-strategic-philanthropy): Pointing to a good character or past good deeds as a reason the present complaint does not need an answer.
- [Halo Effect Exploitation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/halo-effect-exploitation): Answering a concern about someone's behavior by pointing to their achievements, talent or reputation, which have nothing to do with it.
- [Weaponized Therapy-Speak](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/weaponized-therapy-speak): Using therapy words such as boundaries, projecting or triggered to turn someone's limits and complaints into the problem. The real issue goes unanswered.
- [Blame Discard](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/blame-discard): Framing the discard as the target's fault.
- [Managed Exit](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/managed-exit): Orchestrating the departure to maximize the system's control over the narrative.

## Work, school and systems

When an organization, its rules or its paperwork become the weapon.

- [Every tactic on this line, in order](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-systems)
- [Process Exhaustion](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/process-exhaustion): Steps, forms, meetings and re-reviews keep piling up until the person gives up worn out, and not because their matter was decided.
- [Diffusion of Responsibility](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/diffusion-of-responsibility): A decision or harm gets spread across so many people and steps that no one can be found who is answerable for it.
- [Legal / Administrative Threats](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/legal-administrative-threats): Raising the police, lawyers, HR, courts or other authorities as pressure in a personal or workplace dispute, instead of as part of a real process.
- [Confidentiality as Weapon](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/confidentiality-as-weapon): Citing confidentiality rules to keep from someone the accusation, the evidence or even the source of a complaint against them. They are left unable to answer it.
- [HR Shielding](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/hr-shielding): A workplace complaints process that, in practice, protects the organization's reputation and the accused person better than it protects the employee who reported harm.
- [Celebration as Cover](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/celebration-as-cover): Overwork, self-funding or sacrifice is praised in public as dedication, so the shortage that required it is never fixed.
- [Paper-Trail Traps](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/paper-trail-traps): Creating or shaping written records, like write-ups, emails and notes, to build a one-sided case against someone who does not know it is happening.
- [Administrative Escalation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/administrative-escalation): Turning a small, informal concern into a formal complaint, report or legal step that is far heavier than what actually happened.
- [Impossible Metrics](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/impossible-metrics): Giving someone a task or standard they are unlikely to meet with the means given, then treating the miss as proof they are inadequate.
- [Cultural Penalty](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/cultural-penalty): Speech, work or knowledge that differs from one dominant style is marked as wrong or lesser, whatever its substance.
- [Credit Theft](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/credit-theft): Someone presents another person's work, idea or effort as their own, or lets the credit drift away from the person who made it.
- [Credit Laundering](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/credit-laundering): Passing someone's idea or work along through several people, each rewording it a little, until no one can trace it back to the person.
- [Experience Erasure](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/experience-erasure): Real experience, skill or history is declared not to count because it lacks the system's own credential, format or record.
- [Performance Framework Manipulation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/performance-framework-manipulation): Designing ratings, targets and reviews so that agreement and loyalty are rewarded, and skill, dissent and ethical objection are marked down.
- ["Managed Out" Through Exhaustion](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/managed-out-through-exhaustion): Slowly removing a person's meaningful work, visibility and belonging until their leaving looks like a free choice on paper.
- [Individualization of Systemic Issues](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/individualization-of-systemic-issues): Calling a problem of workload, staffing or structure a personal weakness, and expecting the individual to fix it.
- [Abstraction Escalation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/abstraction-escalation): A question about one specific harm is answered with broad statements about values, mission or culture, so the event itself is never named.
- [Agent Erasure](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/agent-erasure): Accounts of what happened leave out who did it ("mistakes were made", "the decision was taken"), so no one is answerable.
- [Captive Expertise](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/captive-expertise): An outside expert is chosen or briefed so their findings support a decision already made, and their credentials are then used to end debate.
- [Done-Deal Framing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/done-deal-framing): A decision is announced as already final and inevitable, so objecting feels pointless before anyone has been asked.
- [Pseudo-Consultation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/pseudo-consultation): Asking for opinions, feedback or comment after the decision is already made, when the input can no longer change anything.
- [Tokenism](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/tokenism): Including one person, or a small number of people, from a group as a visible gesture. They are not given the voice or authority that inclusion seems to promise.
- [Gatekeeping](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/gatekeeping): Controlling who can reach certain people, information, resources or opportunities, so some people must ask permission while others get in without asking.
- [Front-Person Exposure](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/front-person-exposure): One person is made the public face of a decision many people shared, so they take the reaction alone.
- ["Polite Hostile" Environments](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/polite-hostile-environments): A workplace or social setting that stays polite on the surface but quietly punishes anyone who speaks plainly or disagrees.
- [Incident Siloing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/incident-siloing): Each complaint is handled and closed on its own, in its own office or site, so no one is placed to see that the cases form a pattern.
- [Participation Penalty](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/participation-penalty): Taking part, asking for help or speaking up exposes a person to new risk, so staying away becomes the safer choice.
- [Silence as Policy](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/silence-as-policy): Building a workplace culture in which people learn that speaking up brings punishment and staying quiet brings safety.
- [Micromanagement](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/micromanagement): Software that assigns tasks, tracks output and makes decisions about workers' hours, pay or jobs, with little human review.
- [Language Laundering](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/language-laundering): Cuts, losses or harms are described in soft, technical or upbeat words, so they sound like improvements.
- [Metric Masking](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/metric-masking): Averages, color codes and summary figures stand in for what happened to particular people, so overall numbers look fine while specific harm disappears.
- [Self-Fulfilling Prediction](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/self-fulfilling-prediction): A prediction about a person shapes how they are treated, and the outcome that treatment produces is then cited as proof the prediction was right.
- [Policy as Proof](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/policy-as-proof): The existence of a written policy is offered as proof that a problem is handled, in place of evidence that the policy works.
- [Solution Theater](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/solution-theater): A visible purchase, program, support service or announcement is presented as the fix, while the cause of the problem stays untouched.
- [Willful Blindness as Complicity](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/willful-blindness-as-complicity): Not looking into, acknowledging or acting on wrongdoing there is good reason to suspect, so that 'I didn't know' can be said later.
- [Performative Allyship / False Solidarity](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/performative-allyship-false-solidarity): Public support for a cause or group that private actions and choices do not match, so it earns trust it has not backed up.
- [Performative Reception](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/performative-reception): A concern is received with warmth, speed and sympathy, but nothing that follows changes what happened.
- [Weaponized Inclusion / Strategic Containment](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/weaponized-inclusion-strategic-containment): Placing someone in a group or process where they stay visible but have little real influence, so being included replaces acting independently.
- [Manufactured Closure](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/manufactured-closure): The matter is declared resolved or closed by the side that caused it, without the harmed person agreeing and without the harm being named.
- [Accountability Reset](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/accountability-reset): A change of leader, name or program is treated as a fresh start, so earlier promises and failures no longer count against anyone.
- [Record Erasure](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/record-erasure): Records, files or evidence of what happened are deleted, lost or sealed, so the event can later be denied.
- [Paid Silence](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/paid-silence): Money, a reference, a role or another benefit is offered in exchange for not speaking about what happened.
- [Punitive Transfer](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/punitive-transfer): After raising a concern, the person is moved to a different place, team, class or role, presented as routine.
- [Values-Fit Pretext](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/values-fit-pretext): A person's results or questions are redescribed as a mismatch with the group's values or culture, which becomes the reason they have to go.
- [Visible Impunity](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/visible-impunity): The person reported faces no visible consequence, which tells everyone watching that reporting does not work.
- [Closed-Loop Appeals](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/closed-loop-appeals): Challenging a decision sends you back to the same people, rules or system that made it.
- [Development Subordination](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/development-subordination): A person's own learning, health or future is ranked below their usefulness to the system, and that ranking is presented as opportunity.
- [Labor Extraction](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/labor-extraction): Work, time, care or personal money beyond what was agreed or paid is expected and uncounted, often because the role has grown too big or because stopping would hurt the people you serve.
- [Initiative Churn](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/initiative-churn): New programs are launched one after another, so activity looks like progress while none runs long enough to be judged.
- [Liability Reframing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/liability-reframing): A duty to protect or repair is handed to legal or risk management and treated as exposure to limit, then declared expired, out of scope or not owed.
- [Managed Perception](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/managed-perception): Controlling how the system appears to outsiders.
- [Metric-Mission Substitution](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/metric-mission-substitution): The numbers chosen to measure a purpose quietly replace the purpose, and people are judged on the numbers.
- [Motivation Displacement](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/motivation-displacement): Points, scores and rewards replace a person's own reasons for doing something, so they stop when the reward stops.
- [Predictive Tracking](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/predictive-tracking): People are routed into tracks, groups or labels on the strength of a prediction, and the track then limits what they are offered and can become.
- [False Reports](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/false-reports): Making a formal complaint to an employer, school, agency or police that the filer knows is untrue, so the accused answers for something that never happened.
- [Strategic Delay](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/strategic-delay): Responses, records or decisions are slowed until deadlines pass, evidence fades or the person gives up.
- [Structural Underfunding](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/structural-underfunding): The service meant to help is kept too small, too thinly staffed or too run-down to work, and its failure is treated as nobody's fault.
- [Stigma Marking](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/stigma-marking): A person's need, status or condition is made visible to others through separate lines, labels, colors, rooms or lists.
- [Unwritten Rules](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/unwritten-rules): Success depends on expectations nobody states, and people who did not arrive already knowing them are judged as failing.
- [Deniable Authorization](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/deniable-authorization): Permission is given only in conversation or by hint, never in writing, so it can later be denied.

## Control over your life

Rules, monitoring and limits on your time, money, body or choices.

- [Every tactic on this line, in order](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-control)
- [Isolation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/isolation): Steadily cutting a person off from friends, family and other outside support, until only one relationship is left.
- [Omnipresence / Demonstrating Omnipotence](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/omnipresence-demonstrating-omnipotence): Showing off how much someone knows, controls or can reach in your life, until trying to act independently starts to look pointless.
- [Device Access Demands](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/device-access-demands): Insisting on passwords, an unlocked phone or account logins as proof of trust, so that having a private space is read as hiding something.
- [Punishment of Boundaries](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/punishment-of-boundaries): When someone sets a limit, the other person answers with a penalty, such as coldness, withdrawn help or a taken-away privilege. Saying no starts to feel costly.
- [Boundary Testing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/boundary-testing): Someone crosses a stated or implied limit in small steps, and each step that goes unchallenged is followed by a slightly bigger one.
- [Location Tracking](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/location-tracking): Requiring a person to keep their live location visible. Any gap in it is treated as a problem to be explained.
- [Smart-Home Coercion](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/smart-home-coercion): Using connected home devices like locks, cameras, thermostats and speakers to watch, unsettle or control another person at home.
- [Resource Sabotage / Sabotaging Success](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/resource-sabotage-sabotaging-success): Taking away the tools, information, money or help someone needs, and calling the failure proof they are not up to it.
- [Ritualized Exhaustion](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/ritualized-exhaustion): A relentless run of schedules, demands and lost sleep that keeps a person too depleted to think clearly, weigh options or push back.
- [Moving-in-Silence](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/moving-in-silence): Settling a big matter that changes someone else's life without telling or asking them, so they hear about it only when it is finished.
- [Financial Control](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/financial-control): Limiting what someone can reach, see or earn, or using money and assets to pressure them, so they depend on one person.
- [Financial Dependence by Design](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/financial-dependence-by-design): Setting up money, work and account access so that one person cannot manage alone, no matter how either person feels about the relationship.
- [Golden Bars](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/golden-bars): Someone offers real comfort, money or status that comes with unspoken conditions, so leaving or disagreeing means losing a good life.
- ["I Know Best" Paternalism / Velvet Glove Control](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/i-know-best-paternalism-velvet-glove-control): Overriding another adult's choices in the name of what is good for them, and expecting them to be grateful.
- [Enforcing Trivial Demands](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/enforcing-trivial-demands): Insisting on exact compliance with small, pointless-looking rules, treated far more seriously than the stakes deserve, until going along becomes routine.
- [Infantilization](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/infantilization): Treating a capable adult as if they cannot manage their own money, tasks or decisions, and taking those over.
- [Forced Dependency](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/forced-dependency): One person sets up a relationship or setting so the other cannot manage without their ongoing help, and then keeps it that way.
- [Health Sabotage](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/health-sabotage): Interfering with someone's medicine, sleep, food, exercise or medical care in ways that make them weaker and more dependent.
- [Body Autonomy Violations](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/body-autonomy-violations): Controlling the physical body under institutional justification.
- [Mobility Control](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/mobility-control): Restricting physical movement to enforce submission.
- [Document Confiscation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/document-confiscation): Passports, identity papers, visas or certificates are taken "for safekeeping", so leaving, travelling or proving who you are depends on someone else.
- [Debt Bondage](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/debt-bondage): Fees for travel, housing, training or recruitment are charged against future earnings and keep growing, so you must keep working to pay a debt that never clears.
- [Coerced Debt](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/coerced-debt): Loans, credit or bills are taken out in your name, or you are pressured into them, without real consent, so you carry debt for someone else's control.
- [Children as Leverage](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/children-as-leverage): Using children's wellbeing as a tool of control over adults.
- [Enmeshment](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/enmeshment): The line between two people's feelings, choices and identities is dissolved, so your moods, decisions and successes are treated as belonging to someone else. (A family-systems concept.).
- [Financial Enmeshment](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/financial-enmeshment): Tangling finances to make separation catastrophic.
- [Harm to Pets or Property](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/harm-to-pets-or-property): Belongings are destroyed, or a pet is harmed or threatened, as a warning of what could happen next. (Treat as a safety risk: contact local emergency or domestic violence services.).
- [Reproductive Coercion](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/reproductive-coercion): Pressuring or penalizing someone over whether, when or how to have children, using money, work, family standing or withdrawal of support.
- [Arbitrary Authority](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/arbitrary-authority): Decisions follow no stated rule, so nothing you do reliably changes the outcome.
- [Strategic Chaos / Crisis Manufacturing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/strategic-chaos-crisis-manufacturing): Constant emergencies preventing strategic thinking.
- [Collective Punishment](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/collective-punishment): A whole group is punished for something one person did, or for something no one is named for, so the group turns its pressure inward.
- [Fear Installation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/fear-installation): Creating persistent dread through unpredictable consequences.
- [Institutional Capture](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/institutional-capture): Influence is gained over the bodies meant to provide oversight, or outside structures are lined up to enforce, so the place you would turn to for help is already on their side.
- [Status Threats](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/status-threats): Your visa, residency, enrollment or legal status is used as a threat: comply, or you or your family could be reported, removed or deported. (Route to independent legal advice and support services.).
- [Legal Abuse](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/legal-abuse): Repeatedly using court filings, motions and hearings after a separation to drain the other person's money, time and stability.
- [Response-Time Policing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/response-time-policing): Treating the time taken to answer a message as a failing that must be explained, so you feel permanently on call.
- [Interrogation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/interrogation): Demanding that someone explain, justify or defend themselves on command. The demander acts as if an answer is owed, whether or not the person wants to give one.
- [Time Theft](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/time-theft): Someone repeatedly spends another person's time carelessly, through lateness, waiting and canceled plans, as if those hours were worth less than their own.
- [Time Control](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/time-control): Dictating how every hour is spent to prevent autonomous thought.
- [Controlled Communication](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/controlled-communication): Dictating how, when, and whether you may speak.
- [Sleep Deprivation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/sleep-deprivation): Disrupting rest to reduce cognitive and emotional resistance.
- [Choice Restriction](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/choice-restriction): Someone closes off or hides your realistic options one by one, until a single outcome looks like the only sensible choice.
- [Role Assignment](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/role-assignment): Assigning fixed identities that dictate expectation and treatment.
- [Maternal Gatekeeping](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/maternal-gatekeeping): A mother repeatedly corrects, redoes or limits the other parent's or caregiver's care of a child, until that person loses confidence and steps back.
- [Performance Monitoring](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/performance-monitoring): Constant evaluation that installs hypervigilance.
- [Strategic Timing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/strategic-timing): Damaging information or sudden pressure arrives just before an important moment, leaving no time to check or respond.

## Guilt, pressure and fear

Pushing you to say yes through guilt, obligation, urgency or threat.

- [Every tactic on this line, in order](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-pressure)
- [Emotional Blackmail](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/emotional-blackmail): Making love, closeness or the relationship itself depend on doing what someone wants, so that saying no feels like risking the bond.
- [Guilt-Tripping](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/guilt-tripping): Using guilt about past help, sacrifice or hurt feelings to make saying no feel like a moral failing.
- [Duty Scripts](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/duty-scripts): Someone uses a role like daughter, son or parent as a rule nobody can argue with, so refusing sounds like failing at the role.
- ["We're Family" Erasure](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/we-re-family-erasure): Using family loyalty to make fairness, limits and the right to say no seem not to apply between relatives.
- [Concern Trolling / Shame-as-Governance](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/concern-trolling-shame-as-governance): Voicing worry for someone's wellbeing as cover for telling them what to do, so that refusing the advice looks like harming themselves.
- [Overcorrection Demands](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/overcorrection-demands): Overcorrection demands ask for a far larger apology, payment or gesture than a small lapse needs, so repair follows their terms, not the harm.
- [Demand for Gratitude](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/demand-for-gratitude): Expecting thanks on demand, in the right words or amount, as the price of help. The generosity ends up with conditions attached.
- [Loan-Sharking Gifts](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/loan-sharking-gifts): Giving gifts, favors or help in a way that leaves the receiver in debt, so the giving can be used to press a later request.
- [Obligation Hooks](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/obligation-hooks): Handing someone a secret, a sacrifice or a rule they never agreed to, then treating their loyalty as a debt they must pay.
- [Obligation Contracts](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/obligation-contracts): Holding someone to rules or debts they never agreed to and were never told about, then punishing or shaming them when they fall short.
- [Favor Debt](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/favor-debt): Citing past gifts, money or support as the reason someone must agree to a present request. Past kindness is then treated like a signed contract.
- [Guilt Legacy](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/guilt-legacy): Treating a family sacrifice or an ancestor's hardship from before you were born as a debt you repay by doing what is asked.
- [Martyrdom Display](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/martyrdom-display): Pointing out one's own unrewarded effort and sacrifice so that the other person feels in debt and unable to say no.
- [Emotional Hostage-Taking](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/emotional-hostage-taking): Linking your own mood to another person's answer so openly that they feel responsible for keeping you okay.
- [Emotional Blackmail via Self-Harm Threats](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/emotional-blackmail-via-self-harm-threats): Someone says they will hurt or kill themselves if the other person leaves or refuses, tying that person's decision to whether the speaker lives.
- [Withholding / Silent Treatment](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/withholding-silent-treatment): Withholding all communication, warmth or answers from someone, with no stated end. It lasts until they apologize or give in to what the other person wants.
- [Negative Reinforcement Traps](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/negative-reinforcement-traps): A cycle where coldness, criticism or withdrawal stays until someone gives in and then lifts at once, so giving in starts to bring relief.
- [Intimidation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/intimidation): Using a hint or open warning of unwelcome consequences to push someone toward giving in or staying quiet.
- [Ambient Sexual Threat](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/ambient-sexual-threat): A sexually charged or menacing atmosphere around a person, kept alive by repeated small signals. The person stays on guard with nothing definite to report.
- [Sexual Coercion](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/sexual-coercion): Using pressure, guilt, obligation or implied consequences to push someone into sexual activity without their free consent.
- [False Dilemma](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/false-dilemma): Saying there are only two possible answers when more exist, so the person feels pushed toward one.
- [Sunk Cost Exploitation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/sunk-cost-exploitation): Pointing to the time, money or effort already spent as a reason you cannot stop, change course or leave now.
- [Commitment Traps / Foot-in-the-Door](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/commitment-traps-foot-in-the-door): Winning a small yes first, then using it to secure a larger one, so each agreement makes the next harder to refuse.
- [Anchoring to Peak Moments](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/anchoring-to-peak-moments): Referencing past highs to maintain present attachment.
- [Anchoring](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/anchoring): Putting forward a first number, price or claim that then shapes how every later figure and offer is judged.
- [Door-in-the-Face](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/door-in-the-face): Making a big request that is likely to be refused so that the smaller request that follows seems modest and hard to turn down.
- [Legitimizing Paltry Contributions](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/legitimizing-paltry-contributions): A request is framed so that even the smallest contribution counts ("even a little helps"), which makes saying no at all feel unreasonable.
- [Manufactured Scarcity](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/manufactured-scarcity): Claiming that a chance, a person or a deal is about to disappear, so that fear of losing it replaces careful thought.
- [Authority Worship](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/authority-worship): Rank, title or position is presented as beyond question, so deferring feels like a virtue and asking why feels like disrespect.
- [Loyalty Testing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/loyalty-testing): Creating scenarios to test allegiance, then punishing failure.
- [Crisis Bonding](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/crisis-bonding): Manufacturing or escalating crises to bond through shared urgency.
- [Manufactured Urgency](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/manufactured-urgency): Someone pushes for a decision right now, often with an invented or inflated deadline or emergency, so you have no time to think or ask anyone.
- [Cognitive Overload](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/cognitive-overload): Burying someone in more information, steps or demands than they can take in, so they cannot judge a decision clearly.
- [Extinction Bursts](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/extinction-bursts): A sudden, sharper surge of a pressure tactic right after it stops working, as the person tries harder to get the old result back.
- [Ultimatums](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/ultimatums): Demanding that someone pick one of two outcomes right away, with a loss attached to the option the speaker does not want.
- [Reverse Psychology](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/reverse-psychology): Arguing against the outcome you actually want, so that the other person's wish to resist or prove you wrong carries them to it.
- [That's-Not-All](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/that-s-not-all): Before you can answer an offer, extras are added or the price is lowered, so you decide on the sweetened version without time to weigh the original.
- ["Sacred Duty" Manipulation / Mission Framing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/sacred-duty-manipulation-mission-framing): Presenting an ordinary request as a spiritual, moral or ancestral duty, so that saying no is treated as a sin or a betrayal.
- [Bait Disclosure](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/bait-disclosure): Pretending to reveal information to draw the target in, then weaponizing their reaction.
- [Disrupt-Then-Reframe](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/disrupt-then-reframe): An odd or confusing phrase briefly throws you off, and a reassuring reframe arrives in the same breath, so you accept the framing before you have regrouped.
- [Grooming Through Praise](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/grooming-through-praise): Selectively praising behaviors that serve the manipulator.
- [Moral Framing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/moral-framing): Answering someone's boundary, objection or criticism with a judgment of their character, such as selfish or disloyal, instead of with the thing they raised.
- [Moral Outrage as Weapon](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/moral-outrage-as-weapon): Answering a disagreement with intense moral anger far out of proportion, so that questioning it looks like siding with wrongdoing.
- [Rage as Regulation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/rage-as-regulation): Explosive anger that reliably ends a disagreement, whatever lies behind it, because the people nearby learn to give way.
- [Blackmail / Leverage Exploitation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/blackmail-leverage-exploitation): Holding private or damaging information, true or not, over someone to force compliance or silence, under a stated or implied threat of exposure.
- [Reputation Braiding](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/reputation-braiding): Your name is tied in public to the other party early, before any concern exists, so later criticism of them would damage you too.
- [Shared Secret Binding](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/shared-secret-binding): Creating complicity that makes leaving feel like betrayal.
- [Vulnerability Weaponization](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/vulnerability-weaponization): Using shared fears or wounds as leverage.
- [Forced Forgiveness / Weaponized Forgiveness](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/forced-forgiveness-weaponized-forgiveness): Someone presses a person to forgive or move on before the harm has been acknowledged or made right, demanding forgiveness in place of repair.
- [Forced Teaming](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/forced-teaming): Declaring a shared 'we' that the other person never agreed to, so a separate choice starts to look like betrayal.
- [Weaponized Generosity in Public](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/weaponized-generosity-in-public): Grand gestures witnessed by others to build reputation and create invisible obligation.
- [Loyalty Binds](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/loyalty-binds): Defining loyalty as obedience and silence, so that disagreeing, asking questions or telling outsiders counts as betrayal.

## Love that hooks you

Affection, attention and promises used to pull you in and keep you there.

- [Every tactic on this line, in order](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-hook)
- [Intermittent Reinforcement / Push-Pull](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/intermittent-reinforcement-push-pull): A repeating cycle of warmth and distance that leaves the other person working to get back to the warm stretch.
- [Hoovering / Relief Bait](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/hoovering-relief-bait): Reaching out to draw someone back into a relationship after they have pulled away or ended it. This often comes with promises that things will change.
- [Love Bombing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/love-bombing): Flooding someone with intense affection, praise and attention very early. The pace outruns how well the two people actually know each other.
- [Manufactured Intimacy](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/manufactured-intimacy): Creating deep closeness fast, through early confessions and painful sharing, before the two people have any shared history to support it.
- [Future Faking](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/future-faking): Making vivid promises about a better future together that keep you invested in the present. The promised things never seem to arrive.
- [Manufactured Destiny](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/manufactured-destiny): Presenting a relationship as fated or cosmically arranged, so that doubting it, slowing it down or leaving it is treated as going against destiny.
- [Exclusive Meaning](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/exclusive-meaning): Claiming that only this one person truly understands you. Gradually, everyone else in your life seems less worthy of your trust.
- [Pedestal Ploy / The Exception Script](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/pedestal-ploy-the-exception-script): Telling you that you are uniquely different from everyone around you. Keeping that special status then depends on staying close to the speaker.
- [Premature Vulnerability / Trauma Dumping](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/premature-vulnerability-trauma-dumping): Deep disclosures too early to create obligation and recruit caretaking.
- [The Rescue Hook](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/the-rescue-hook): Showing a need that seems helpless, so you take over tasks or feelings unasked and your effort is treated as devotion.
- [Emotional Parasitism](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/emotional-parasitism): A steady one-way arrangement where one person's feelings get the attention and care, and the other is drained with little given back.
- [Pocketing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/pocketing): You are kept apart from the other person's friends, family and public life, so the relationship exists only in private, with no witnesses. (Informal term from dating culture; no peer-reviewed research was found.).
- [Bread-crumbing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/bread-crumbing): Sending just enough occasional attention to keep someone hopeful and available, while the contact never turns into real plans or commitment.
- [Ghosting as Control](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/ghosting-as-control): Cutting off all contact with no explanation and then returning later, leaving the other person with questions they cannot settle.
- [Emotional Flooding](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/emotional-flooding): Pouring on emotion so fast and so hard that the other person cannot think, until speed and intensity get mistaken for closeness.
- [Identity Auditing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/identity-auditing): Mapping the target's vulnerabilities for strategic use.
- [Premature Trust Extraction](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/premature-trust-extraction): Pressuring the target to share before earning the right to hold it.
- [Gatekeeper Grooming](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/gatekeeper-grooming): The people around a target, such as parents, colleagues or an institution, are won over first, so that later access goes unquestioned and concerns are not believed.
- [Target Selection](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/target-selection): One person is singled out for special attention because they look most isolated, most eager or most useful, and the attention feels like being chosen.
- [Pacing and Leading](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/pacing-and-leading): First matching the target's rhythm, then shifting it toward dependency.
- [Mirroring-on-Demand](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/mirroring-on-demand): Quickly copying your interests, opinions and way of speaking so you feel unusually understood, whether or not the match is real.
- [Splitting](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/splitting): Seeing a person or group as all good or all bad, with no middle ground, and flipping that view suddenly after a minor event.
- [Confirmation Bias Exploitation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/confirmation-bias-exploitation): Supplying enough good moments that your own habit of favoring the kinder reading does the work of discounting the harm.
- [Premature Exclusivity](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/premature-exclusivity): Pushing someone to commit exclusively and seriously before they have had time to know you well enough to choose freely.
- [Orbiting](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/orbiting): Watching from a distance to maintain psychological presence after discard.
- [Rescuer Positioning](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/rescuer-positioning): Presenting as the answer to the target's confusion or fear.
- [Identity Hooking](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/identity-hooking): Saying that someone's identity, skills or successes belong to you, so that standing apart from you means giving up the self they have built.
- [Replacement Display](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/replacement-display): Publicly showcasing your replacement to signal your disposability.
- [Sudden Devaluation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/sudden-devaluation): An abrupt shift from investment to disposal.

## Put-downs that wear you down

Insults, contempt and slow erosion of how you see yourself.

- [Every tactic on this line, in order](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-wear)
- [Shame Installation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/shame-installation): Treating a person's mistake as proof that something is wrong with them as a whole, so shame replaces guilt.
- [Comparative Devaluation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/comparative-devaluation): Holding a person up against someone else, again and again, in a way that always leaves them coming up short.
- [Negging](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/negging): Slipping in a subtle insult, wrapped as a compliment or a joke. You end up feeling a little smaller and a little more eager for approval.
- [Name-Calling Disguised as Humor](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/name-calling-disguised-as-humor): Putting an insult or demeaning label inside a joke, so that if you object, you can be accused of overreacting.
- [Contempt](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/contempt): Treating someone with open disgust or superiority. It is aimed at who they are, not at anything they did.
- [Performative Public Affection / Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/performative-public-affection-dr-jekyll-and-mr-hyde): Showing one warm, admired face to the world and another harsh one to a particular person. Nobody else sees how that person is treated.
- [Ambient Abuse / Atmosphere Control](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/ambient-abuse-atmosphere-control): A steady climate of tension, criticism and unpredictability. No single moment looks serious, but the whole leaves a person worn down.
- [Emotional Invalidation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/emotional-invalidation): Telling someone that what they feel is wrong, silly or not allowed, instead of accepting that they feel it.
- [Baiting](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/baiting): Provoking someone into an angry or upset reaction, then pointing to that reaction as the real problem.
- ["You've Changed"](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/you-ve-changed): Your growth, new views or new limits are described as losing your true self, so changing feels like betraying the people around you.
- [Emotional Contamination](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/emotional-contamination): Ruining positive states through sudden intrusion.
- [Exoticization](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/exoticization): A culture or identity is shown only as costume, festival or novelty, never as ordinary, present and complex.
- [Public Exposure](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/public-exposure): Someone embarrasses or puts down a person in front of others, or puts private matters on show, so the audience adds to the sting.
- [Dehumanization](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/dehumanization): Dehumanization reduces a person to a label, a number or a problem, so decisions about them leave no room for their point of view.
- [Objectification](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/objectification): Treating a person as a tool, a body or a source of output, so that only what they supply seems to count about them.
- [Conditional Love](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/conditional-love): Treating a person's value as something that rises and falls with their usefulness and their willingness to comply.
- [Parentification](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/parentification): A child or partner is put in the permanent role of caring for an adult's feelings, practical needs and crises, at the cost of their own development.
- [Toxic Positivity / Weaponized Optimism](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/toxic-positivity-weaponized-optimism): Toxic positivity insists on cheer in answer to real pain or a real complaint, so the feeling becomes the problem and its cause goes unexamined.
- [Accountability Evasion via Diagnosis / Trash-Can Diagnosis](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/accountability-evasion-via-diagnosis-trash-can-diagnosis): Using a mental-health label about someone as an insult, a verdict, or a way to treat their limits and reactions as symptoms.

## Groups, cults and propaganda

Influence over whole groups: high-control groups, propaganda and influence operations.

- [Every tactic on this line, in order](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-society)
- [Phobia Indoctrination / Catastrophizing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/phobia-indoctrination-catastrophizing): Intense, out-of-proportion dread attached to actions like leaving, disagreeing or trusting outsiders, until avoiding them is a bodily reflex and not a reasoned choice.
- [Dispensing of Existence](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/dispensing-of-existence): A group's doctrine sorts people by who deserves to exist or counts as fully human, which makes harm to outsiders, critics and former members seem justified.
- [Doctrine Over Person](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/doctrine-over-person): Teaching members that if their own experience, memory or conscience contradicts the group's doctrine, then the experience, and not the doctrine, must be wrong.
- [Sacred Science](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/sacred-science): Treating the group's doctrine as beyond question, so a doubt is read as a flaw in the doubter and the claim goes unexamined.
- [Charismatic Authority Dependence](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/charismatic-authority-dependence): Making a single leader the only trusted source of truth, meaning and safety, so that winning the leader's approval becomes a member's deepest need.
- [Echo Chamber Construction](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/echo-chamber-construction): Arranging what another person reads, hears and talks about so they mostly meet one view and see every other source as unreliable.
- [Controlled Opposition](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/controlled-opposition): A protest group, critic or movement secretly funded, steered or shaped by the power it seems to oppose, so dissent goes somewhere harmless.
- [Astroturfing / Sock Puppets](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/astroturfing-sock-puppets): Making a campaign look like spontaneous public support when it is staged, funded or run by a hidden sponsor.
- [Agent of Influence Operations](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/agent-of-influence-operations): A public figure, such as a journalist, academic, politician or executive, who is secretly guided by an outside party while seeming to speak independently.
- [Cyber Manipulation Operations (CMOs)](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/cyber-manipulation-operations-cmos): Quietly changing, inventing or deleting data inside a system, so people make decisions based on records they believe are real.
- [Strategic Leaking](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/strategic-leaking): Releasing sensitive information through channels that look unauthorized, so a planned disclosure looks like a secret that got out.
- [False Flag Operations](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/false-flag-operations): Arranging an event to look like another group's work, so a response seems justified or the blamed party is harmed.
- [Manufactured Consent](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/manufactured-consent): Steering what the public sees and hears so that agreement with a decision looks like free choice when it was guided.
- [Information Laundering](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/information-laundering): Passing a false or unverified claim through a series of apparently credible sources until it looks like established fact and its origin can no longer be seen.
- [Forced Confession / Self-Criticism Rituals](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/forced-confession-self-criticism-rituals): Required, repeated sharing of faults, doubts or past wrongs with the group, which brings shame and gives the group material it can hold over people.
- [Humiliation Rituals](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/humiliation-rituals): A formal routine of shaming people in front of others, presented as initiation or growth, where the pain is treated as proof it works.
- [Mystical Manipulation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/mystical-manipulation): Staging events that look spontaneous or divine, like visions, healings or signs, to persuade members that a leader holds special spiritual authority.

## Online and technology

Fake accounts, deepfakes, tracking, scams and pressure through screens.

- [Every tactic on this line, in order](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-online)
- [Coordinated Reporting](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/coordinated-reporting): Organized mass reporting of an account or post, often on false grounds, to get a platform to remove or restrict it.
- [Doxxing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/doxxing): Publishing a person's private details, such as a home address or workplace, so others can find or harass them.
- [AI Voice Cloning](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/ai-voice-cloning): Software-made copies of a real person's voice, used to impersonate them in calls, messages or recordings.
- [Social Engineering](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/social-engineering): Getting someone to hand over information, access or action by playing on their trust, urgency or habits, usually with a false story.
- [Account Control](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/account-control): Taking over someone's email, social media, banking or cloud accounts, so they are watched, spoken for and cut off from their online life.
- [Black-Box Decisions](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/black-box-decisions): Consequential decisions come from a system whose workings cannot be seen, explained or meaningfully questioned.
- [Algorithmic Manipulation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/algorithmic-manipulation): Using feed ranking and recommendation systems to steer what a person sees and feels, in ways they cannot inspect or switch off.
- [Algorithmic Targeting of Vulnerable Populations](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/algorithmic-targeting-of-vulnerable-populations): Finding people in a weak moment through their data, then targeting them with exploitative offers, scams or harmful content.
- [Biometric Exploitation](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/biometric-exploitation): Reading someone's face, voice or body signals in real time, often without clear knowledge, to time or tune an attempt to influence them.
- [Immersive Manipulation (VR/AR)](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/immersive-manipulation-vr-ar): Using virtual or augmented reality experiences to make staged scenarios seem real enough to shape someone's fears, beliefs or attachments.
- [Parasocial Manipulation Engineering](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/parasocial-manipulation-engineering): Building a one-sided feeling of friendship or closeness with an audience, then using it to draw out loyalty, money, personal information or compliance.
- [Buried Consent](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/buried-consent): Agreement is collected through long, vague or scattered terms that no ordinary person can realistically read, then treated as full and informed consent.
- [Forced Continuity](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/forced-continuity): A free or low-cost start turns into ongoing payment or commitment without a clear moment where you choose to continue.
- [Gamified Compulsion](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/gamified-compulsion): Streaks, badges, levels and progress bars make stopping feel like losing something already earned.
- [Persistent Nagging](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/persistent-nagging): The same request or prompt keeps coming back, with no way to make it stop, until giving in is easier than saying no again.
- [Catfishing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/catfishing): Building an online relationship behind a made-up identity, such as borrowed photos or an invented life story, so someone bonds with a person who does not exist.
- [Context Poisoning](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/context-poisoning): Planting misleading or tampered material in shared information sources, or in AI training data, so that later readers and tools inherit the error.
- [Data Harvesting](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/data-harvesting): Detailed information about behavior, location, feelings or performance is collected continuously and built into a profile, far beyond what the service needs.
- [Data Onward Sharing](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/data-onward-sharing): Information collected for one purpose is passed, sold or shown to others, often described as anonymized, without the person's real knowledge.
- [Swatting](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/swatting): A false emergency report brings an armed or emergency response to someone's home or school, using the authorities as a weapon. (Treat as an emergency safety risk.).
- [Uncorrected Record](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/uncorrected-record): The accusation is public, loud and lasting, while any correction is quiet or missing, so the first version stays.
- [Intimate Image Abuse](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/intimate-image-abuse): Sharing or threatening to share private sexual images of someone without consent, including fake ones, often with a demand for money, contact or compliance.
- [Reputation Hijacking](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/reputation-hijacking): Someone takes control of how you are presented in public, speaking for you or reshaping your image, so your own account no longer reaches people first.

Sitemap: https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/sitemap.xml
